products.Tagline: ERP + HRM + Internal Email in one database
products.Short_Description: The flagship all-in-one suite: operations, inventory, workforce, payroll and built-in internal email — three critical systems for one SME bundle price.
products.Value_Highlight: 3-in-1 SME Suite: ERP + HRM + Built-in Internal Email — Real Operational Discipline Without SAP/Oracle Costs
products.Overview: ProEase+ combines ProEase ERP, ProEase HRM and a built-in internal email and memo system on one unified database. Goods receipts, purchase requests and leave applications don't get lost in WhatsApp groups or personal inboxes — they route straight to the right manager's @internal inbox for one-click sign-off, and every decision lands in the audit trail.
products.Why_Switch: Most SMEs run stock in one spreadsheet, attendance in another, and approvals over chat. Records drift apart, nobody can say who approved what, and month-end becomes a reconciliation exercise. ProEase+ brings the same receive–issue–count–approve discipline used in enterprise SAP environments, without the licensing bill or the consultants.
products.Customization: Approval chains, document numbering, departments, warehouses and bins, leave types, payroll items and memo templates are configured to your procedures during setup. Additional custom modules or reports can be scoped on request.
products.Database_Security: Dedicated Database Setup :: Your company gets its own database instance, set up and migrated by us — your data is never mixed with another client's | Company Network Lock :: Staff can only sign in from approved office, warehouse or store Wi-Fi public IPs, which stops off-site clock-ins and outside data access. Admins refresh the approved IP in one click when broadband changes, and Business Owners / Super Admins can bypass remotely | Approved Device Lock :: Access is bound to authorised company laptops, tablets or terminals using a cryptographic device token plus hardware fingerprint. Unrecognised personal devices stay blocked — even on company Wi-Fi — until an Admin approves them | Role-Based Access Control :: Operator, Supervisor and Owner permissions are separated, so the person who keys a transaction is not the one who approves it | Immutable Audit Trail :: Every stock movement, issuance and approval is logged with timestamp, user and device ID, and cannot be edited after the fact
products.Bundle_Components: ProEase ERP :: Operations, purchasing, goods receiving, stock issuance, cycle counts and sales | ProEase HRM :: Staff records, attendance, leave, payroll and uniform / asset issuance | Internal Email & Memos :: Database-backed @internal inboxes and department memos with zero per-seat email fees | Dual Security Locks :: Company network lock plus approved-device lock, with RBAC and an immutable audit trail
products.How_It_Works: Discovery & Configuration :: We map your receiving, issuance, approval and HR procedures and configure the suite to match | Dedicated Database Setup :: Your own database is provisioned and your item master, staff list and opening stock are migrated in | Network & Device Enrolment :: Office, warehouse and store IPs are approved and company devices are registered | Go Live :: Staff work from approved devices, and approvals flow to managers' internal inboxes for one-click sign-off
products.Key_Benefits: One Database, No Double Entry :: Stock, staff and approvals share one source of truth | Approvals in One Click :: GRNs, purchase requests and leave land in the manager's internal inbox | Zero Per-Seat Email Fees :: Internal @internal mailboxes for every staff member at no extra cost | Stock You Can Trust :: PO-matched receiving and approved cycle-count variances | Off-Site Clock-Ins Blocked :: Attendance only from approved networks and devices | Audit-Ready Every Day :: Every movement and approval traceable to a user, time and device

products.Tagline: Operations, inventory and sales — run like a real warehouse
products.Short_Description: Lean, procedure-driven ERP for goods receiving, stock issuance, cycle counts, purchasing and sales.
products.Value_Highlight: SAP-style receive, issue and count procedures — sized for SME teams and budgets
products.Overview: ProEase ERP covers the daily inventory loop that breaks first when a business outgrows spreadsheets: receiving goods against a purchase order, issuing stock against a request, counting regularly and approving variances before stock is adjusted. Sales, purchasing and stock levels stay in step because they come from the same transactions.
products.Why_Switch: In a spreadsheet anyone can overwrite a stock balance and nobody knows why it changed. In ProEase ERP stock only moves through a receipt, an issue, a transfer or an approved count adjustment — the same principle enterprise systems rely on.
products.Customization: Item master structure, units of measure, warehouses and bins, document numbering, approval thresholds and printable forms (GRN, issue slip, delivery order) are configured to your business.
